description: This file defines extension methods (guard clauses) for Basket-related validation, specifically checking if a basket is empty at checkout. The method throws an exception if the basket is empty.

classes.name: BasketGuards
classes.description: A static class providing guard clause extension methods for Basket validation tasks.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckout
methods.description: Extension method that checks if the basket items collection is empty and throws an exception if it is.
